meta.note: Class defect: 19 Iraq gas rows carry a spurious miles->km conversion of the OPEC ASB length column. Staged as VALIDITY concerns (not fills) because each targets a populated, published value. Memo: notes/escalation-2026-07-28-asb-iraq-length-units.md

resolutions.recommendation: Set LengthKnownKm 145 -> 90 (spurious mi->km on the ASB Iraq block)
resolutions.researcher_notes: CLASS DEFECT (ASB length units). GEM LengthKnownKm=145 km is exactly 90 x 1.609344 = 144.84. OPEC ASB Table 4.10/9.9 [2012+2017] lists "North Gas/Baiji (2017: Kirkuk/Baiji)" at 90 under a column headed "(miles)", but the IRAQ block is tabulated in KILOMETRES, so the mi->km conversion applied at ingest is spurious. Corroboration that this is the right ASB row and not a numeric coincidence: the ASB diameter for that row is 24 in and GEM carries 24.00. This row has no drawn route, so it is confirmed by arithmetic + diameter only. Proposed LengthKnownKm=90 (the ASB figure read as km). DO NOT paste over LengthMergedKm (computed). Scope + controls: notes/escalation-2026-07-28-asb-iraq-length-units.md. Baird's ruling needed before apply.
